periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle downward from the medial to the lateral side.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovaloid morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.3:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering is visible, with the lowest point of the patch extending well below the horizontal midline of the eye.
